mapper.select: SELECT id AS group_binding_id,tenant_id,integration_id,namespace,external_group_ref,lifecycle_ref,business_scope_id,session_id,status,revision FROM nw_group_bindings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND id=#{group}
SELECT FROM nw_group_source_messages WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND source_message_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM nw_group_source_messages WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND source_event_id=#{event}
SELECT FROM nw_group_triggers WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND trigger_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM nw_group_triggers WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND source_message_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM nw_group_triggers WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND status='queued' ORDER BY trigger_sequence LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,source_sequence,trigger_sequence,active_trigger_id,active_run_id FROM nw_group_front_slots WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group}

SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id,source_sequence,trigger_sequence,active_trigger_id,active_run_id FROM nw_group_front_slots WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_group_front_slots(tenant_id,integration_id,group_binding_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{integration},#{group}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_group_front_slots SET source_sequence=#{sequence} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND source_sequence=#{sequence}-1
UPDATE nw_group_front_slots SET trigger_sequence=#{sequence} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND trigger_sequence=#{sequence}-1

UPDATE nw_group_triggers SET status='accepted',input_id=#{input},run_id=#{run} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND trigger_id=#{id} AND status='queued'
UPDATE nw_group_front_slots SET active_trigger_id=#{id},active_run_id=#{run} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND active_trigger_id IS NULL

UPDATE nw_group_triggers SET status='rejected',rejection_code=#{reason} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND trigger_id=#{id} AND status='queued'
UPDATE nw_group_front_slots SET active_trigger_id=NULL,active_run_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND active_run_id=#{run}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}::text AND session_id=#{session} AND run_id=#{run} AND phase='FINISHED')
SELECT FROM nw_group_source_messages WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND source_sequence <= #{through} ORDER BY source_sequence
SELECT id::text FROM nw_tenants WHERE id::text > #{after} ORDER BY id::text LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.integration_id,s.group_binding_id,s.source_sequence,s.trigger_sequence,s.active_trigger_id,s.active_run_id FROM nw_group_front_slots s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (s.active_run_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_group_triggers t WHERE t.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND t.integration_id=s.integration_id AND t.group_binding_id=s.group_binding_id AND t.status='queued')) ORDER BY s.group_binding_id LIMIT 100

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.integration_id,s.group_binding_id,s.source_sequence,s.trigger_sequence,s.active_trigger_id,s.active_run_id FROM nw_group_front_slots s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.group_binding_id > #{after} AND (s.active_run_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_group_triggers t WHERE t.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND t.integration_id=s.integration_id AND t.group_binding_id=s.group_binding_id AND t.status='queued')) ORDER BY s.group_binding_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT g.id FROM nw_group_bindings g JOIN nw_integration_business_scopes b ON (b.tenant_id,b.integration_id,b.scope_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.business_scope_id) JOIN nw_tenants n ON n.id=g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.integration_id=#{integration} AND g.id=#{group} AND g.status='active' AND b.status='active' AND n.status IN('active','warning') FOR SHARE OF g,b,n) qualification)

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT m.end_user_id FROM nw_group_memberships m JOIN nw_end_users e ON e.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND e.external_integration_id=m.integration_id AND e.id=m.end_user_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.integration_id=#{integration} AND m.group_binding_id=#{group} AND m.end_user_id=#{user} AND m.status='active' AND e.status='active' FOR SHARE OF m,e) qualification)

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT g.id FROM nw_group_bindings g JOIN nw_group_memberships m ON (m.tenant_id,m.integration_id,m.group_binding_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id) JOIN nw_group_service_agents a ON (a.tenant_id,a.integration_id,a.group_binding_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id) JOIN nw_integration_business_scopes b ON (b.tenant_id,b.integration_id,b.scope_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.business_scope_id) JOIN nw_end_users e ON e.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND e.external_integration_id=g.integration_id AND e.id=m.end_user_id JOIN nw_service_principals p ON p.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND p.integration_id=g.integration_id JOIN nw_tenants n ON n.id=g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.integration_id=#{integration} AND g.id=#{group} AND g.status='active' AND m.end_user_id=#{user} AND m.status='active' AND a.agent_id=#{agent} AND a.status='active' AND b.status='active' AND e.status='active' AND n.status IN('active','warning') AND p.principal_id=#{principal} AND p.status='active' AND p.scopes @> '["groups.triggers.write"]'::jsonb FOR SHARE OF g,m,a,b,e,p,n) current_qualification)

SELECT tenant_id,integration_id,actor_ref,operation,group_binding_id,request_key,fingerprint,response::text AS response FROM nw_group_message_requests WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND group_binding_id=#{group} AND actor_ref=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND request_key=#{key}
